schema.description: Create a PENDING request, then approve it with the same setup and trial contract as manual approval. Approval failure leaves the PENDING request available for review.

templateKey.description: Supported values are presets 1, 2, and 3, or -1 for a custom checklist. Semantic validation runs after the PENDING request is committed.

setupSteps.description: Custom checklist items are validated by the shared setup resolver after the PENDING request is committed.

requestBody.description: Create a PENDING request, then approve it with the same setup and trial contract as manual approval. Approval failure leaves the PENDING request available for review.
